cq_coverage.1: The class InterchangeEnvelope with the object property containsMessage (range: Message/InvoiceMessage) allows listing all invoices in an EDIFACT message.
cq_coverage.2: The pivot class OrganizationRoleAssignment, via involvesOrganization and hasOrganizationRole (from InvoiceMessage), captures all organizations involved in the invoice.
cq_coverage.3: OrganizationRoleAssignment's hasRole property (linked to AgentRole) enables querying the role of any organization (e.g., S) in the invoice.
cq_coverage.4: Filtering OrganizationRoleAssignment instances where hasRole = Buyer and retrieving involvesOrganization yields the buyer organization for an invoice.
cq_coverage.5: Organization and Address classes, linked via OrganizationRoleAssignment and hasAddress, provide all information about involved organizations.
cq_coverage.6: For the buyer, OrganizationRoleAssignment with hasRole=Buyer and hasAddress yields the buyer's address.
cq_coverage.7: LineItem (linked from DetailSection) and hasItem (to Item) allow listing all items sold in the invoice.
cq_coverage.8: Item class with itemDescription data property provides information about items sold.
cq_coverage.9: Price class with netPrice data property (linked from LineItem via hasPrice) gives net prices of sold items.
cq_coverage.10: HeaderSection, DetailSection, and SummarySection (linked from InvoiceMessage via hasSection) provide invoice details.
cq_coverage.11: SummarySection with totalAmount data property gives the invoice amount.
cq_coverage.12: InvoiceMessage with invoiceNumber data property provides the invoice number.
cq_coverage.13: SimpleDataElement, CompositeDataElement, Segment, and InvoiceMessage classes, with relevant properties, ensure all required information for file format validity (e.g., mandatory identifiers).
cq_coverage.14: InvoiceMessage assignedToBusinessProcess property links invoices to business processes.
